items.title: Jim Hall — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know Chet Baker well. I knew about him for years and everything... Chet sees Jane Herbert Hall and so he says… He looks at me and says, “A chick wrote that, man? Wow.”

ctx.x: Yeah, Rodrigo. That’s right, yeah. Yeah. I loved, you know, the melody and everything. It seemed a bit cheap to use that, but the musicians that were together, that, that was incredible. I love… I really enjoyed listening to it just recently, too, ‘cause it… it starts out with Ron playing a tremolo, which he does beautifully on a high D or something. And I play the melody, and I guess I overdubbed an acoustic guitar. Played some chords. And then Chet Baker comes in, repeating the melody, and he plays it…
